verdict.rationale: AMD's ROCm docs describe full-stack documentation and recipes for deploying AI workloads with popular ROCm-enabled frameworks, list vLLM and SGLang for inference, and place the MI325X in the ROCm GPU spec table as gfx942. That shows first-party framework support for this GPU, but the pack never names PyTorch and shows no compatibility or support matrix. Community doubt about whether the software stack works in practice is not concrete counter-evidence. missing for 10: explicit PyTorch build/install documentation, a framework/ROCm version support matrix listing MI325X, hands-on corroboration of frameworks running on MI325X.

support.subject: As an ML engineer, PyTorch and mainstream ML frameworks run on this GPU through officially documented builds and support matrices

citations.quote: Full-stack documentation and recipes to deploy AI workloads on AMD GPUs using popular ROCm-enabled frameworks.
